profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Corporate Investment Bank Technology
Athena Trade and Risk Platform
Athena Core Risk Team

Resolve production issues with the Risk Platform by conducting post-issue reviews, root-cause analyses, and implementing solutions. 

Evaluate system performance, conduct tests, document findings, and pinpoint areas for optimization.

Take a proactive stance in identifying issues, performance bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

Python, AWS, Kubernetes

positions.title: National Coordinator
positions.description:
• Administrating nationwide member information, events resources, bank accounts and more.
• Organising nationwide events and managing resources, finances and event attendances.
• Resolving issues and overcoming obstacles to ensure proper legislation and standards are met.
• Marketing events and conferences to potential delegates and sponsors – social media and personal.
• Booking flights, hotels, and itineraries for delegates travelling to conferences overseas.

positions.title: Credit and Mortgage - Database and Platform Engineer
Website Project Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Develop sample programs to demonstrate business processes using C#.
•	Design website wireframes and comprehensive flowcharts of required website functionalities.
•	Collaborate with sales team and management team to clearly define website requirements.
•	Work with website engineers and UI designers to bring website functionalities to life.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed and debugged new applications and services with C#, WPF, Web API, ASP.Net MVC, and Coldfusion.
•	Worked in an agile software development environment. 
•	Built and maintained databases i.e. Microsoft SQL Server 
•	Prioritised requirements and ensured proper time management to avoid system downtime.
•	Tested new applications and features – unit testing, integration testing, system testing and user acceptance testing. 
•	Optimized code and modernising company legacy programs.
•	Researched technologies for future projects and development of the company.

positions.title: Class Representative
positions.description:
•	Elected by students.
•	Relayed information from administration to students and vice versa.
•	Consoled lecturers and classmates about their concerns.
•	Contributed ideas to improve our college course for current and incoming students.

positions.title: Sales Adviser
positions.description:
•	Assisted customers to find what they need and advised customers on product selection.
•	Provided excellent customer service in a very busy shop environment.
•	Supervised and made sure that stock levels are right and cleaned the stock rooms.
•	Mastered the Point-Of-Sale system and was delegated responsibility of working at the cash desk.
•	Received training regarding basic healthcare products and over-the-counter medicines.
•	Displayed the store products in a clean and aesthetically presentable manner.
•	Answered customer phone calls and help them with their enquiries and complaints in an efficient way.
•	Supported the store management team in achieving good business results. 
•	Developed good working relationships with the staff teams in which I have been placed.

positions.title: National Conference Secretariat (VOLUNTEER)
positions.description:
•	Created and designed an online database to manage finances and delegation attendance.
•	Managed finances.
•	Organised conference bank accounts.
•	Marketed conference to potential delegates. 
•	Negotiated with various hotels for conference venue.

positions.title: Parish Council Member	(VOLUNTEER)
positions.description:
•	Has been recommended by teachers to the local parish, as a parish council member.
•	Learned valuable lessons easily and quickly.
•	Expected to put my ideas forward in helping the parish influence young people.
•	Worked in teams to make our ideas work.

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description:
•	Volunteered every year for secondary school to collect clothes and goods for St. Vincent De Paul.
•	Spread awareness to locals that we will be collecting clothes and goods at a certain date and time. 
•	Worked with my team to collect from people’s houses, as efficiently as possible.

honors.title: Adele Farrell Scholarship
honors.description: I have been awarded a full scholarship by the Dublin Business School.
honors.issuer: Issued by Dublin Business School · May 2015

honors.title: Chemistry - Achievement Award
honors.issuer: Issued by Assumption Secondary School · May 2015
